page_title: RMA 5-1 VAL | Real Madrid v Valencia 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 5 - 1 Hugo Duro (Valencia) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
86' Hugo Duro (Valencia) touches the ball with his hand.

84' 5 - 0 Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Giorgi Mamardashvili is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 5:0.
82' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
82' Here is a change. Daniel Carvajal is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Paz (Real Madrid).
82' That will be all from Vinicius Junior who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joselu (Real Madrid).
78' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.

78' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Giorgi Mamardashvili, who tips the ball around the post.
77' Javi Guerra (Valencia) brings his opponent down. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Fouls committed – 6:21.
74' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' The shot by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili.
71' Ferland Mendy comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
71' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Brahim Diaz will be replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
70' Substitution. Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) in, Pepelu out.
70' Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fran Perez.
69' A pass by Luka Modric (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
68' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
67' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Gabriel Paulista (Valencia).
64' Substitution. Sergi Canos is replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
62' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
61' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
61' Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
61' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:2.
60' Substitution. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replaces Federico Valverde.
56' A yellow-coloured card is received by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
55' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) replaces Jose Gaya.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) replaces Thierry Correia.
53' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Fran Perez (Valencia) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
50' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds the back of the net with a precise, technical shot into the bottom right corner. A brilliant individual effort.
49' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
48' An attempted cross from Fran Perez (Valencia) is cleared.
47' The attendance is 72475.
46' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) trips an opposition player and Jose Sanchez signals a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
45+3' Thierry Correia (Valencia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45+1' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the direct free kick, but drags his shot well wide of the left post.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' It looks like Thierry Correia (Valencia) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
42' 2 - 0 It’s a GOAL! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is the first to get on the end of a lofted pass and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
41' Hugo Duro (Valencia) meets a cross from Pepelu, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
40' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner with a short pass.
40' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
34' Pepelu (Valencia) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
34' Pepelu (Valencia) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
32' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) brings an opponent down and Jose Sanchez interrupts the game.
31' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
28' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) heads on.
27' A cross from Jose Gaya (Valencia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
27' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
25' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
24' The game is interrupted now, Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Javi Guerra (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle.
21' Javi Guerra (Valencia) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
18' Thierry Correia (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.
16' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.

15' Hugo Duro (Valencia) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Andriy Lunin anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
13' Thierry Correia (Valencia) sends a long ball in, but Andriy Lunin comfortably gathers the ball.
11' Hugo Duro (Valencia) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Andriy Lunin pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
9' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
9' The corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
6' David Alaba (Real Madrid) takes the free kick, but it sails wide of the target. The goalkeeper didn't have to react at all.
5' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Sanchez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

3' 1 - 0 A good lofted pass from Toni Kroos finds Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the bottom right corner. The score is now 1:0.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Valencia will kick-off.
Jose Sanchez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
